Descriptive bibliometrics and impact

biblioIntegrator team

v03-descriptive-impact.Rmd

Purpose

Descriptive indicators are useful summaries, but their interpretation depends on coverage and citation window. Normalized scores compare within explicit strata.

Workflow 

x <- as_biblio_project(example_biblio())
describe_biblio(x)

Interpretation

Results should be interpreted in relation to database coverage, time window, entity normalization and analytical thresholds. Provenance should be retained whenever data are merged, deduplicated or enriched.
